Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/markdown', uri: 'https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md'), { 'language_detection' => { 'detect_multiple' => true, 'enabled' => true, 'min_confidence' => 0.3 } })
puts result.results[0].detected_languages.inspect
```
